main.description: A public offer by a seller. Describes stable facts about the thing offered. Dynamic stock state lives in app.temp.commerce.inventory, temporary price rules in app.temp.commerce.promotion.

fulfillmentKind.description: Delivery-kind dimension. Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup.

purchase.description: Purchase-mechanism dimension: how a consumer proceeds from discovery to purchase. Absent means no purchase path is advertised.

title.description: Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup when absent.

description.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

price.description: Normal/base offer price, before any promotion. Promotions are separate records and never rewrite this value.

category.description: Coarse category. Required unless partOf is set, in which case it is inherited from the productGroup.

classifications.description: Detailed classification in external, independently versioned taxonomies. A listing may participate in several at once. Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

specifications.description: Structured product properties. Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

brand.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

identifiers.description: External product identifiers (GTIN, ISBN, MPN). Usable by indexers as a cross-seller join key without a canonical catalog layer.

images.description: Inherited from the productGroup when absent and partOf is set.

shopRef.description: AT URI of the parent shop record

partOf.description: AT URI of the parent productGroup, if this listing is a variant

variantProperties.description: Concrete variant property tuple (e.g. [{axis: Color, value: Red}, {axis: Size, value: M}])

details.description: Intrinsic facts specific to a fulfillment kind. Physical properties are first-class fields, not a union member.

hideFromFriends.description: Social privacy: hide this listing from friends/followers

externalPurchase.description: Purchase completes on an external site (e.g. a marketplace or the seller's own storefront)

checkoutPurchase.description: Purchase begins at a checkout endpoint the seller controls. This schema describes the entry point only; checkout, payment, and reservation are transactional concerns outside the protocol.

informational.description: The listing advertises an offer but is not directly purchasable — e.g. contact-for-quote, or a catalog entry sold offline

serviceDetails.description: Intrinsic fields for services and commissions

fileFormat.description: File format or type (e.g. PDF, PNG, ZIP)

deliveryMethod.description: How the digital good is delivered
